children: (NYSE: INFQ) (the “Company”), a global leader in quantum computing and quantum sensing powered by neutral-atom technology, announced its participation at Quantum World Congress 2026, taking place Sept. 23-25, 2026, in College Park, Maryland.

Infleqtion leaders will participate in multiple sessions throughout the event, including roundtable discussions focused on the advancement and application of quantum technologies. Quantum World Congress brings together scientists, CEOs, government leaders and investors from across the global quantum ecosystem to explore breakthroughs, partnerships and the continued commercialization of quantum technology.
Battlefield to Orbit: Delivering Operational ‘Quantum’ Advantage
Panel 1: Defense Reality: Engineering Quantum for Defense
Panel 2: Quantum in Space — What’s Next for the Space Race
Resilient Supply Chain & Manufacturing for Quantum Systems at Commercial Scale

Attendees can also visit Infleqtion at Booth 23/25 in Section 2, near the main stage, during the event to learn more about the company’s quantum computing, sensing and timing technologies and connect with members of the team.
Location: The Hotel at the University of Maryland, College Park, Maryland

Infleqtion, Inc. (NYSE: INFQ) is a global leader in quantum technology, delivering neutral-atom solutions for quantum computing, networking, sensing, and security. With a product portfolio spanning quantum computers, quantum optical clocks, RF receivers, and inertial sensors, Infleqtion’s full-stack approach combines high-performance hardware with the company’s proprietary Superstaq quantum computing software platform. Infleqtion’s systems are already in use by the U.S. Department of War, NASA, the U.K. government, and in multiple collaborations with NVIDIA. Infleqtion, in collaboration with NVIDIA, published the world’s first demonstration of a materials science application using logical qubits. With operations in the U.S., Europe, and Asia, Infleqtion meets the demands of government and commercial customers across the space, defense, energy, finance and telecommunications sectors.
